thesis: 截至09:33 SGT，周末市场的绑定约束已经从“CPI是否会逼近加息”切换为“Saudi East-West 4–5m bpd Hormuz bypass停运能否在周日油市重开前恢复”：周五Brent在外交希望下回落2.81%至$104.61、美股反弹，但沙特随后确认预防性关闭East-West pipeline，叠加Hormuz航运受限与Houthi控制Perim，意味着周五风险资产的缓和定价面临明显weekend gap risk。与此同时8月CPI环比+0.4%、core +0.3%，Fed下周加息概率升至约86–90%，因此能源供给与利率两条约束正重新同向。
dominant_narrative: 周五市场给出的表面信号是risk relief：S&P 500上涨0.86%、VIX降至15.88、Brent回落2.81%；但这些价格形成在Saudi正式确认East-West pipeline关闭之前，因此不能把Friday close当作周末风险的最终答案。新的约束是三层叠加：Hormuz海运已受限、Perim令Bab el-Mandeb风险上升、4–5m bpd East-West陆上绕行又暂时关闭，而美国CPI和消费者通胀预期已经把Fed推向更鹰路径。下一个有效确认不是更多headline，而是周日/周一油价重开后WTI/Brent、UST 2Y与股指期货是否同向重新定价。

top_catalysts.event: Saudi Arabia shuts East-West pipeline after drone attack, removing a 4–5 million bpd Hormuz bypass
top_catalysts.event_time_et: 2026-09-11 evening EDT / confirmed by Sep12 Asia morning
top_catalysts.what_happened: Saudi Arabia temporarily shut the 1,200-km East-West pipeline as a precaution after a drone attack. Reuters reports the line had recently moved roughly 4–5 million barrels per day, equal to about 4–5% of global oil supply, and had become a critical bypass while Strait of Hormuz tanker traffic was constrained.
top_catalysts.what_changed: Sep11 reporting described attack damage; by Sep12 Saudi Arabia had confirmed an actual shutdown, converting threatened capacity into a realized routing constraint.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: Friday’s oil pullback and equity rebound closed before this confirmation, so the first liquid futures sessions must price a materially worse physical-routing state.
top_catalysts.transmission: Pipeline outage → less Hormuz bypass capacity → higher crude/freight premium → higher inflation expectations → higher front-end yields → pressure on duration and cyclicals.
top_catalysts.confirmation: Pipeline remains shut or repair timing extends while Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb flows remain impaired; energy futures reopen materially above Friday settlement.
top_catalysts.invalidation: Saudi Arabia restores meaningful East-West throughput quickly and at least one major Gulf/Red Sea shipping route improves without new attacks.

top_catalysts.event: U.S. August CPI rises 0.4% m/m and pushes September Fed hike odds to roughly 86–90%
top_catalysts.what_happened: August U.S. CPI rose 0.4% month-on-month and 3.4% year-on-year. Core CPI rose 0.3% month-on-month and 2.4% year-on-year; gasoline jumped 3.9%. Rate futures moved to roughly an 86–90% probability of a 25bp Fed hike while the official 2Y Treasury yield closed at 4.63%.
top_catalysts.what_changed: The CPI binary event is now known and has shifted the policy question from whether the Fed can hike to how much tightening is already embedded in front-end rates.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: An energy-driven inflation shock is interacting with firmer monthly core inflation and higher consumer inflation expectations, increasing the risk of a broader policy response.
top_catalysts.transmission: CPI/core acceleration → higher Fed hike probability → higher 2Y/real yields and tighter dollar liquidity → valuation compression for long-duration and financing-sensitive assets.
top_catalysts.confirmation: 2Y yields hold near or above Friday levels and Fed pricing remains strongly tilted to a September hike despite any weekend decline in crude.
top_catalysts.invalidation: Fed pricing retreats materially before the meeting because energy risk reverses quickly or incoming data weakens enough to dominate the inflation impulse.

top_catalysts.event: Perim seizure and record VLCC freight rates turn Middle East shipping risk into a two-chokepoint cost shock
top_catalysts.what_happened: Iran-aligned Houthis reached strategic Perim Island at Bab el-Mandeb while Strait of Hormuz traffic remained sharply reduced. Gulf of Oman-to-China VLCC freight reached roughly Worldscale 450, equivalent to about $11.50 per barrel, as tanker availability and insurance costs tightened.
top_catalysts.what_changed: The market is no longer pricing only a Hormuz bottleneck; Bab el-Mandeb and the Saudi land bypass are simultaneously impaired or threatened.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: Freight and insurance costs can broaden the commodity shock into delivered fuel prices even if benchmark crude temporarily retreats, increasing second-round inflation risk.
top_catalysts.transmission: Two-chokepoint shipping stress + record freight → higher delivered energy costs → weaker real income and margins → higher inflation expectations → tighter global policy bias.
top_catalysts.confirmation: VLCC rates stay near records, Hormuz transits remain depressed and Houthi control around Perim persists through the weekend.
top_catalysts.invalidation: Shipping security improves enough to restore tanker availability and freight rates fall materially while Perim ceases to constrain Bab el-Mandeb traffic.

top_risks.risk: Saudi East-West pipeline停运与Hormuz/Bab el-Mandeb受限叠加，替代出口能力同时收缩
top_risks.why_not_fully_priced: Saudi正式确认停运发生在周五主要现金市场收盘之后，Friday Brent -2.81%和VIX 15.88没有完整计入周末信息。
top_risks.trigger: 周末仍无明确修复时间表，或出现新的能源设施/船舶攻击。
top_risks.transmission: 实体出口能力下降 → crude/freight risk premium → 通胀预期 → Fed/ECB更紧 → 风险资产折现率上升。
top_risks.confirmation_evidence: East-West line closed; Perim held by Houthis; Hormuz constrained.
top_risks.invalidation_evidence: Meaningful pipeline throughput restoration and improved maritime transit.

top_risks.risk: CPI与能源二次冲击共同把Fed从单次加息推向更长时间的高利率路径
top_risks.why_not_fully_priced: 市场已把Sep16加息概率推至约86–90%，但Saudi pipeline关闭发生在CPI后，新的能源信息尚未反映在周五Treasury close。
top_risks.trigger: 油价/运费周日重开上行，同时2Y在4.63%附近或更高维持。
top_risks.transmission: 能源成本 + core inflation → 更鹰Fed路径 → 2Y/real yield上升 → Nasdaq、小盘、融资密集AI资产承压。
top_risks.invalidation_evidence: Energy risk reverses and Fed pricing falls materially before the meeting.

top_risks.risk: Fed与BOJ同步收紧预期导致日元carry unwind独立于美元方向扩散
top_risks.why_not_fully_priced: USDJPY周五已跌0.45%至153.69且日元连续第二周走强，但风险资产仍在周五反弹，尚未出现全面去杠杆。
top_risks.trigger: BOJ加息预期增强，同时Fed保持鹰派且周末能源冲击抬高全球波动率。
top_risks.transmission: 日元融资成本上升 → carry仓位减持 → 高beta与杠杆资产卖出 → VIX/跨资产相关性上升。
top_risks.confirmation_evidence: USDJPY 153.69; yen +0.45% Friday and second weekly gain.
top_risks.invalidation_evidence: USDJPY reverses higher while BOJ expectations soften and equity breadth stays firm.

next_catalyst.event: CME WTI weekly reopen after Saudi East-West pipeline shutdown
next_catalyst.status: Confirmed Upcoming / first liquid weekend-risk price discovery
next_catalyst.consensus: No reliable point consensus; focus is the gap versus Friday $100.05 WTI settlement after the pipeline shutdown confirmation.
next_catalyst.previous: WTI Friday settlement $100.05/bbl, -2.37% on the day but up more than 8% on the week.
next_catalyst.why_it_matters: This is the first liquid benchmark able to price the confirmed 4–5 million bpd East-West pipeline shutdown together with Perim/Hormuz stress. The opening gap will determine whether Friday’s cross-asset relief survives into Monday.
next_catalyst.bull_interpretation: WTI opens contained or below Friday settlement and stays there as credible repair/shipping updates reduce the physical premium; rates and equity futures confirm.
next_catalyst.bear_interpretation: WTI gaps materially above Friday settlement and persists alongside higher Treasury/fx volatility, showing the supply shock has overtaken Friday’s tactical relief.
watch_first: WTI/Brent：比较周日重开与Friday $100.05/$104.61 settlement的gap，并观察首小时是否维持而非瞬时跳升。
UST 2Y / equity futures：若油价上行同时2Y收益率与S&P/Nasdaq futures走弱，说明能源→Fed→估值传导得到跨资产确认。
Saudi pipeline / Hormuz / Perim flow updates：只有可核验的修复吞吐或航运恢复，才足以否定纯headline驱动的risk premium。
